description: Viratra saree pattern taxonomy. Hand-curated design categories used across the classifier, search index and catalog. These classes are bespoke domain knowledge, not derived from a single published paper.

patterns.label: Floral
patterns.note: Flowering vines, blossoms and leaf motifs; the most common decorative field.

patterns.label: Paisley
patterns.note: Mango / kairi (ambi) teardrop motif, often on pallu and border.

patterns.label: Temple
patterns.note: Triangular temple-tower (gopuram) border, classic to South Indian silks.

patterns.label: Checks
patterns.note: Grid / chequered fields, common in cotton handloom (e.g. Ilkal, Madras checks).

patterns.label: Stripes
patterns.note: Directional line fields, warp or weft striping.

patterns.label: Geometric
patterns.note: Diamonds, zig-zags and lattice motifs; strong in Pochampally / ikat.

patterns.label: Butta
patterns.note: Small repeated single motifs (buttis) scattered across the body.

patterns.label: Abstract
patterns.note: Free-form / non-repeating decorative fields that do not fit the above.
